units.text: The President of the Russian Federation:
units.label: Art. 83 · “The President of the Russian Federation:”

units.text: а) appoints the Chairman of the Government of the Russian Federation, whose candidacy has been approved by the State Duma on the President's submission, and removes the Chairman of the Government of the Russian Federation from office;
units.label: Point «а» Art. 83

units.text: б) exercises overall direction of the Government of the Russian Federation; may chair meetings of the Government of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point «б» Art. 83

units.text: б.1) approves, on the proposal of the Chairman of the Government of the Russian Federation, the structure of federal executive bodies and makes changes to it; within that structure, determines the bodies whose activities are directed by the President of the Russian Federation and those directed by the Government of the Russian Federation. If the Chairman of the Government of the Russian Federation is removed from office by the President of the Russian Federation, the newly appointed Chairman does not submit proposals on the structure of federal executive bodies to the President;
units.label: Point «б» Art. 83 · “б.1) approves, on the proposal of the Chairman of the…”

units.text: в) decides on the resignation of the Government of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point «в» Art. 83

units.text: в.1) accepts the resignation of the Chairman of the Government of the Russian Federation, Deputy Chairmen of the Government of the Russian Federation, federal ministers and heads of federal executive bodies whose activities are directed by the President of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point «в» Art. 83 · “в.1) accepts the resignation of the Chairman of the Government…”

units.text: г) submits to the State Duma a candidate for appointment as Chairman of the Central Bank of the Russian Federation; raises before the State Duma the question of removing the Chairman of the Central Bank of the Russian Federation from office;
units.label: Point «г» Art. 83

units.text: д) appoints Deputy Chairmen of the Government of the Russian Federation and federal ministers whose candidacies have been approved by the State Duma (except the federal ministers referred to in point ‘д.1’ of this Article), and removes them from office;
units.label: Point «д» Art. 83

units.text: д.1) appoints, after consultations with the Federation Council, and removes from office heads of federal executive bodies (including federal ministers) responsible for defence, state security, internal affairs, justice, foreign affairs, prevention of emergencies and elimination of the consequences of natural disasters, and public safety;
units.label: Point «д» Art. 83 · “д.1) appoints, after consultations with the Federation Council,…”

units.text: е) submits to the Federation Council candidates for appointment as Chairman, Deputy Chairman and judges of the Constitutional Court of the Russian Federation, and Chairman, Deputy Chairmen and judges of the Supreme Court of the Russian Federation; appoints chairmen, deputy chairmen and judges of other federal courts;
units.label: Point «е» Art. 83

units.text: е.1) appoints, after consultations with the Federation Council, and removes from office the Prosecutor General of the Russian Federation, Deputy Prosecutors General of the Russian Federation, prosecutors of constituent entities of the Russian Federation and prosecutors of military and other specialized procuracies equivalent to prosecutors of constituent entities; appoints and removes from office other prosecutors for whom federal law establishes this procedure of appointment and removal;
units.label: Point «е» Art. 83 · “е.1) appoints, after consultations with the Federation Council,…”

units.text: е.2) appoints and removes representatives of the Russian Federation in the Federation Council <19>;
units.label: Point «е» Art. 83 · “е.2) appoints and removes representatives of the Russian…”

units.text: е.3) submits to the Federation Council a proposal to terminate, in accordance with federal constitutional law, the powers of the Chairman, Deputy Chairman and judges of the Constitutional Court of the Russian Federation, the Chairman, Deputy Chairmen and judges of the Supreme Court of the Russian Federation, and the chairmen, deputy chairmen and judges of cassation and appellate courts, if they commit an act disgracing a judge's honour and dignity, or in other cases provided for by federal constitutional law indicating that a judge is unable to exercise their powers;
units.label: Point «е» Art. 83 · “е.3) submits to the Federation Council a proposal to terminate,…”

units.text: е.4) submits to the Federation Council candidates for appointment as Chairman of the Accounts Chamber and half of its total number of auditors; submits to the State Duma candidates for appointment as Deputy Chairman of the Accounts Chamber and half of its total number of auditors;
units.label: Point «е» Art. 83 · “е.4) submits to the Federation Council candidates for…”

units.text: е.5) forms the State Council of the Russian Federation to ensure coordinated functioning and interaction of public authorities, determine the main directions of the domestic and foreign policy of the Russian Federation and the priority directions of the State's socioeconomic development; the status of the State Council of the Russian Federation is determined by federal law;
units.label: Point «е» Art. 83 · “е.5) forms the State Council of the Russian Federation to…”

units.text: ж) forms the Security Council of the Russian Federation to assist the head of State in exercising powers concerning national interests and the security of the individual, society and the State, maintaining civil peace and concord in the country, protecting the sovereignty, independence and state integrity of the Russian Federation, and preventing internal and external threats; heads the Security Council of the Russian Federation. The status of the Security Council of the Russian Federation is determined by federal law;
units.label: Point «ж» Art. 83

units.text: з) approves the military doctrine of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point «з» Art. 83

units.text: и) forms the Administration of the President of the Russian Federation to support the exercise of the President's powers;
units.label: Point «и» Art. 83

units.text: к) appoints and removes plenipotentiary representatives of the President of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point «к» Art. 83

units.text: л) appoints and removes the high command of the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point «л» Art. 83

units.text: м) appoints and recalls diplomatic representatives of the Russian Federation to foreign States and international organizations after consultations with the relevant committees or commissions of the chambers of the Federal Assembly.
units.label: Point «м» Art. 83

units.text: <19> Article 83 was supplemented with point ‘е.2’ in accordance with the Law of the Russian Federation on an Amendment to the Constitution of the Russian Federation No. 11-ФКЗ of 21 July 2014, ‘On the Federation Council of the Federal Assembly of the Russian Federation’, which entered into force on the date of its official publication, 22 July 2014 (Official Internet Portal of Legal Information (www.pravo.gov.ru), 2014, 22 July, No. 0001201407220002).
units.label: Art. 83 · “<19> Article 83 was supplemented with point ‘е.2’ in accordance…”

units.text: Article 84
units.label: Art. 84

units.text: The President of the Russian Federation:
units.label: Art. 84 · “The President of the Russian Federation:”

units.text: а) calls elections to the State Duma in accordance with the Constitution of the Russian Federation and federal law;
units.label: Point «а» Art. 84

units.text: б) dissolves the State Duma in the cases and in the manner provided for by the Constitution of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point «б» Art. 84

units.text: в) calls a referendum in the manner established by federal constitutional law;
units.label: Point «в» Art. 84

units.text: г) submits bills to the State Duma;
units.label: Point «г» Art. 84

units.text: д) signs and promulgates federal laws;
units.label: Point «д» Art. 84

units.text: е) addresses the Federal Assembly with annual messages on the situation in the country and the main directions of the State's domestic and foreign policy.
units.label: Point «е» Art. 84

units.text: Article 85
units.label: Art. 85

units.text: 1. The President of the Russian Federation may use conciliation procedures to resolve disagreements between bodies of state authority of the Russian Federation and bodies of state authority of its constituent entities, and between bodies of state authority of constituent entities of the Russian Federation. If an agreed solution is not reached, the President may refer the dispute for resolution to the appropriate court.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 85

units.text: 2. The President of the Russian Federation is entitled to suspend acts of executive bodies of constituent entities of the Russian Federation if those acts contradict the Constitution of the Russian Federation, federal laws or the international obligations of the Russian Federation, or violate human and civil rights and freedoms, pending a decision on the matter by the appropriate court.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 85

units.text: Article 86
units.label: Art. 86

units.text: The President of the Russian Federation:
units.label: Art. 86 · “The President of the Russian Federation:”

units.text: а) directs the foreign policy of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point «а» Art. 86

units.text: б) conducts negotiations and signs international treaties of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point «б» Art. 86

units.text: в) signs instruments of ratification;
units.label: Point «в» Art. 86

units.text: г) receives the letters of credence and recall of diplomatic representatives accredited to the President.
units.label: Point «г» Art. 86

units.text: Article 87
units.label: Art. 87

units.text: 1. The President of the Russian Federation is Supreme Commander-in-Chief of the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 87

units.text: 2. In the event of aggression against the Russian Federation or an immediate threat of aggression, the President of the Russian Federation introduces martial law throughout the territory of the Russian Federation or in particular localities, immediately informing the Federation Council and the State Duma.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 87

units.text: 3. The regime of martial law is determined by federal constitutional law.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 87

units.text: Article 88
units.label: Art. 88

units.text: In the circumstances and in the manner provided for by federal constitutional law, the President of the Russian Federation introduces a state of emergency throughout the territory of the Russian Federation or in particular localities, immediately informing the Federation Council and the State Duma.
units.label: Art. 88 · text

units.text: Article 89
units.label: Art. 89

units.text: The President of the Russian Federation:
units.label: Art. 89 · “The President of the Russian Federation:”

units.text: а) decides matters of citizenship of the Russian Federation and the granting of political asylum;
units.label: Point «а» Art. 89

units.text: б) confers state awards of the Russian Federation, honorary titles of the Russian Federation, and the highest military and special ranks;
units.label: Point «б» Art. 89

units.text: в) grants pardons.
units.label: Point «в» Art. 89

units.text: Article 90
units.label: Art. 90

units.text: 1. The President of the Russian Federation issues decrees and executive orders.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 90

units.text: 2. Decrees and executive orders of the President of the Russian Federation are binding throughout the territory of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 90

units.text: 3. Decrees and executive orders of the President of the Russian Federation must not contradict the Constitution of the Russian Federation or federal laws.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 90

units.text: Article 91
units.label: Art. 91

units.text: The President of the Russian Federation enjoys immunity.
units.label: Art. 91 · text

units.text: Article 92
units.label: Art. 92

units.text: 1. The President of the Russian Federation begins exercising powers upon taking the oath and ceases exercising them at the expiry of the term of office, when the newly elected President of the Russian Federation takes the oath.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 92

units.text: 2. The President of the Russian Federation ceases exercising powers before the expiry of the term in the event of resignation, persistent inability for health reasons to exercise the powers vested in the President, or removal from office. In that event, the election of the President of the Russian Federation must take place no later than three months after the early termination of the exercise of powers.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 92

units.text: 3. Whenever the President of the Russian Federation is unable to perform the duties of office, they are temporarily performed by the Chairman of the Government of the Russian Federation. The Acting President of the Russian Federation has no right to dissolve the State Duma, call a referendum or submit proposals to amend or revise provisions of the Constitution of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 92

units.text: Article 92.1
units.label: Art. 92.1

units.text: 1. A President of the Russian Federation who has ceased exercising powers because of the expiry of the term of office, or prematurely because of resignation or persistent inability for health reasons to exercise the powers vested in the President, enjoys immunity.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 92.1

units.text: 2. Other guarantees for a President of the Russian Federation who has ceased exercising powers because of the expiry of the term of office, or prematurely because of resignation or persistent inability for health reasons to exercise the powers vested in the President, are established by federal law.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 92.1

units.text: 3. A President of the Russian Federation who has ceased exercising powers may be deprived of immunity in the manner provided for by Article 93 of the Constitution of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 92.1
